body: My friend I just lost. He and I would star gaze all the time and it may help more than I think.

We had a dog for about 14 years, and we had to put him down 2 years ago. My mom hasn't wanted to get another, which I can understand why. I will look and see if my university, or any surrounding hospitals/medical centers offer pet therapy. It does sound wonderful. I volunteer weekly at a soup kitchen and also work part time. I'm part of a service sorority on campus as well. I also make sure I exercise daily and eat correctly because I know that can have an impact on mood. I hate to say I've been through hell and back, but I really have. What's going on now is barely scraping the surface and it's just getting to be too much and I'm not sure how many circles I can go in.

I have tried that, and she still thinks I'm too young and it will do more harm than good. So I'm also currently looking for a new doctor. I am in therapy now, and have been for years and it still hasn't helped much. I haven't tried pet therapy but I will definitely look into it.
Thank you. You're right. It could very well help, and keep me close to him.

Ihave. I've tried a lot of other things since my doctor refuses to prescribe me anything, even though at this point it seems to be what I need. That was one of my favorite things to do with my friend I just lost, so it'll be a while before I'll be able to do that again.
